bg-24-01.say: 창밖을 보니까 비가 오는 것 같아요
answers: 창밖을 보니까 비가 오는 것 같아요
창밖을 보니 비가 오는 것 같아요
bg-24-01.hint: Looking outside the window, it seems to be raining.
bg-24-01.why: Action verbs in the present take -는 것 같다: 오- + -는 것 같아요.

bg-24-01.q: Express your softened impression that the weather seems hot today. Use 날씨 + -이/가 and adjective 덥다 (ㅂ irregular) + -(으)ㄴ 것 같아요.
bg-24-01.why: 덥다 is a ㅂ-irregular adjective: 덥- + -(으)ㄴ 것 같아요 → 더운 것 같아요.

bg-24-01.h: Present Impression: Adjective -(으)ㄴ 것 같다 vs Verb -는 것 같다

a.d: Attaches to adjective stems to soften an impression about a state or quality.
ex: 오늘 날씨가 조금 **더운 것 같아요**. / I think the weather is a bit hot today.
이 방이 아주 **조용한 것 같아요**. / It seems this room is very quiet.

b.h: 동사 + -는 것 같다 (observing an action in progress)
b.d: Attaches to action verb stems to guess what action is currently taking place.
ex: 창밖을 보니까 비가 **오는 것 같아요**. / Looking outside, it seems to be raining.
저기서 사람들이 춤을 **추는 것 같아요**. / Over there, it looks like people are dancing.

bg-24-01.tip: For descriptive states and qualities, use -(으)ㄴ 것 같다 (바쁜 것 같다, 좋은 것 같다); for ongoing actions in progress, use -는 것 같다 (먹는 것 같다, 오는 것 같다).

steps.en: It seems to be raining right now.
Looking out the window, it seems to be raining right now.

ko: 창문을 열어 보니 밖에서 시원한 바람이 불어요.
창밖을 보니까 지금 비가 오는 것 같아요.
날씨가 조금 쌀쌀한 것 같아서 겉옷을 입었어요.
en: Opening the window, a cool breeze blows from outside.
Looking outside, it seems to be raining right now.
I felt that the weather was a bit chilly, so I put on a jacket.

bg-24-01.q: What did the writer observe looking at the sky?
options: It seems to be raining right now
bg-24-01.why: The text says '창밖을 보니까 지금 비가 오는 것 같아요' (Looking at the sky, it seems to be raining soon).

bg-24-01.q: Why did the writer put on a jacket?
options: Because the weather felt a bit chilly
Because they were going to an interview
bg-24-01.why: The text states '날씨가 조금 쌀쌀한 것 같아서 겉옷을 입었어요' (I felt that the weather was a bit chilly, so I put on a jacket).

items: Soften direct assertions into considerate impressions with -것 같다
Distinguish adjective -(으)ㄴ 것 같다 from verb -는 것 같다 in present observations

bg-24-02.say: 하늘이 흐려서 곧 비가 올 것 같아요
answers: 하늘이 흐려서 곧 비가 올 것 같아요
bg-24-02.hint: The sky is overcast, so it seems like it will rain soon.
bg-24-02.why: Predicting an upcoming event uses -(으)ㄹ 것 같다: 올 것 같아요.

bg-24-02.q: Predict that tomorrow's weather will be good. Use time word 내일 and 좋다 + -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요.
bg-24-02.why: Predicting future qualities attaches -(으)ㄹ 것 같다: 좋을 것 같아요.

steps.en: I think it will rain soon.
Because the sky is dark, I think it will rain soon.

ko: 일기예보를 보니까 밤에 비가 올 것 같아요.
그래서 외출할 때 가방에 작은 우산을 챙겼어요.
en: Dark clouds have filled the sky since this afternoon.
Looking at the weather forecast, it seems like it will rain tonight.
So when going out, I packed a small umbrella in my bag.

bg-24-02.q: What does the weather forecast predict for tonight?
options: It seems like it will rain
It will be sunny and clear
bg-24-02.why: The text states '일기예보를 보니까 밤에 비가 올 것 같아요' (Looking at the weather forecast, it seems like it will rain tonight).

bg-24-02.q: What did the writer pack when leaving home?
bg-24-02.why: The text states '외출할 때 가방에 작은 우산을 챙겼어요' (I packed a small umbrella in my bag).

items: Make future conjectures and forecasts using -(으)ㄹ 것 같다
Conjugate irregular adjectives (어려울 것 같아요, 더울 것 같아요) accurately

bg-24-03.say: 바닥이 젖은 걸 보니까 비가 온 것 같아요
answers: 바닥이 젖은 걸 보니까 비가 온 것 같아요
바닥이 젖은 것을 보니까 비가 온 것 같아요
bg-24-03.hint: Seeing that the ground is wet, it seems it rained.
bg-24-03.why: Evidence of past actions uses -(으)ㄴ 것 같다: 온 것 같아요.

bg-24-03.q: State that you think your friend has already arrived. Use 친구 + -이/가 and 오다 + -(으)ㄴ 것 같아요.
bg-24-03.why: To guess that an action took place in the past, use [Verb-(으)ㄴ] 것 같아요.

steps.en: Looking at the ground, it seems it rained earlier.

ko: 아침에 일어나서 밖을 보니 도로가 젖어 있었어요.
하지만 지금은 해가 떠서 날씨가 맑을 것 같아요.
en: Waking up in the morning and looking outside, the road was wet.
It seems it rained at dawn.
However, now the sun is rising, so I think the weather will be clear.

bg-24-03.q: Why did the writer guess that it rained at dawn?
bg-24-03.why: The text states '도로가 젖어 있었어요. 새벽에 비가 온 것 같아요' (The road was wet. It seems it rained at dawn).

bg-24-03.q: What does the writer predict about the weather today?
options: It will be clear because the sun is rising
It will rain heavily all day
bg-24-03.why: The text states '지금은 해가 떠서 날씨가 맑을 것 같아요' (Now the sun is rising, so I think the weather will be clear).

items: Differentiate past -(으)ㄴ 것 같다, present -는 것 같다, and future -(으)ㄹ 것 같다
Infer past events based on physical traces and evidence

bg-24-04.say: 제 생각에는 이 색이 더 예쁜 것 같아요
answers: 제 생각에는 이 색이 더 예쁜 것 같아요
내 생각에는 이 색이 더 예쁜 것 같아요
bg-24-04.hint: In my opinion, I think this color is prettier.
bg-24-04.why: 예쁘다 is an adjective ending in a vowel, attaching -ㄴ 것 같다 → 예쁜 것 같아요.

bg-24-04.q: Softly say you feel the size is a bit small. Use 사이즈 + -이/가 and 작다 + -(으)ㄴ 것 같아요.
bg-24-04.why: 작다 has a consonant batchim, attaching -은 것 같다 → 작은 것 같아요.

bg-24-04.wrong: 오늘 하늘을 보니까 날씨가 맑는 것 같아요.
answers: 오늘 하늘을 보니까 날씨가 맑은 것 같아요.
오늘 하늘을 보니까 날씨가 맑은 것 같아요
bg-24-04.hint: 맑다 is an adjective ending in a consonant, taking -은 것 같다: 맑- + -은 것 같아요 → 맑은 것 같아요.
bg-24-04.why: Adjectives take -(으)ㄴ 것 같다, not -는 것 같다: 맑은 것 같아요.

steps.en: I think this dress is prettier.
In my opinion, I think this dress is prettier.

ko: 친구가 파란색 셔츠를 입고 어떠냐고 물었어요.
저는 친구에게 하얀색 셔츠가 더 잘 어울리는 것 같다고 말했어요.
en: I picked out clothes with a friend at the department store.
My friend tried on a blue shirt and asked how it looked.
I told my friend that the white shirt seems to suit them better.

bg-24-04.q: What did the friend try on first?
bg-24-04.why: The text states '친구가 파란색 셔츠를 입고 어떠냐고 물었어요' (My friend tried on a blue shirt).

bg-24-04.q: What was the writer's softened opinion?
options: The white shirt seems to suit them better
bg-24-04.why: The text states '하얀색 셔츠가 더 잘 어울리는 것 같다고 말했어요' (I told my friend that the white shirt seems to suit them better).

items: Deliver polite, non-confrontational critiques and impressions using -(으)ㄴ/는 것 같다
Express personal tastes and stylistic feedback considerately
